art_instructions: Render a cozy familyhouse interior at a child’s eye level in soft morning light. Center foreground: Owl (a small chibi owl with mottled brown-and-cream feathers) is sitting up in a low, round nest-like bed on the wooden floor, pushing back a pastel cream-green blanket as she wakes; her green scarf is loosely draped around her neck. Show the waking action clearly: one eye half-open and the other just opening, tiny beak in a soft yawn, wings stretching outward and slightly upward, body leaning forward from the bed. To the left of Owl, include a low window with cream curtains and warm sunlight streaming in, forming a gentle, soft-edged highlight on the floor. To the right, place a woven basket and her tiny satchel resting beside it; hang an acorn lantern on a small wall hook above, and set a small potted soft-green plant and a low stool with a simple ceramic cup nearby. Background stays simple and airy: warm wooden wall boards and a short shelf with one or two plain ceramics; avoid any text or symbols. Use the Korean aegyo cute style with clean monoline strokes, flat pastel colors with soft green accents, and minimal cel shading; keep lighting diffuse top-front and fill the frame with these cozy elements for balance and clarity.
